<![CDATA[import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { DM_Mono, Dela_Gothic_One, Zen_Kaku_Gothic_New } from "next/font/google";
import "./koji/koji.css";

// Both families include Japanese glyphs split into ~100 unicode-range slices. Preloading would fetch all of
// them (~3 MB); without it the browser downloads only the slices for characters actually on the page.
const display = Dela_Gothic_One({ weight: "400", subsets: ["latin", "latin-ext"], variable: "--font-dela-gothic", preload: false });
const body = Zen_Kaku_Gothic_New({
  weight: ["400", "500", "700"],
  subsets: ["latin", "latin-ext"],
  variable: "--font-zen-kaku",
  preload: false,
});
const mono = DM_Mono({ weight: ["400", "500"], subsets: ["latin"], variable: "--font-dm-mono" });

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "KŌJI 麹 — Fermentation kitchen, Tower 1972, Ginza",
  description:
    "Eleven courses built on kōji, miso and shio, served at a twelve-seat concrete counter inside a 1972 Metabolist tower in Ginza.",
};

export default function KojiLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={`${display.variable} ${body.variable} ${mono.variable}`}>
      <body className="kj-body">{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(koji)/koji/assets.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { ASSETS } from "./assets.generated";

const BASE = "/templates/koji";

/** URL for a processed image, or null when the owner hasn't generated it yet. */
export function assetSrc(key: string, width: 800 | 1600, format: "webp" | "avif" = "webp"): string | null {
  return key in ASSETS ? `${BASE}/${key}-${width}.${format}` : null;
}

type PictureProps = {
  assetKey: string;
  alt: string;
  className?: string;
  sizes?: string;
  priority?: boolean;
};

/** A responsive <picture>, or a labelled concrete placeholder until the image exists. */
export function Picture({ assetKey, alt, className, sizes = "(min-width: 900px) 50vw, 100vw", priority }: PictureProps) {
  const webp800 = assetSrc(assetKey, 800);
  if (!webp800) {
    return (
      <div className={`kj-placeholder ${className ?? ""}`} role="img" aria-label={alt} data-asset={assetKey}>
        <span className="kj-mono">{assetKey}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const { w, h } = ASSETS[assetKey];
  const set = (format: "webp" | "avif") =>
    `${assetSrc(assetKey, 800, format)} 800w, ${assetSrc(assetKey, 1600, format)} 1600w`;
  return (
    <picture className={className}>
      <source type="image/avif" srcSet={set("avif")} sizes={sizes} />
      <img
        src={webp800}
        srcSet={set("webp")}
        sizes={sizes}
        width={w}
        height={h}
        alt={alt}
        loading={priority ? "eager" : "lazy"}
        fetchPriority={priority ? "high" : undefined}
        decoding="async"
        data-asset={assetKey}
      />
    </picture>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(koji)/koji/koji.css">
<![CDATA[@import "tailwindcss";

/* ─────────────── KŌJI design tokens: concrete, plus one signal ─────────────── */
@theme {
  --color-sumi: #1A1918; /* ink-black: hero, omakase, chef, footer */
  --color-shadow: #4A4743; /* concrete in shade: rules, slab wipe */
  --color-beton: #8E8A83; /* béton brut: kitchen and reservation slabs */
  --color-washi: #EDEAE4; /* paper: text on dark, building slab */
  --color-shu: #C8331F; /* vermilion seal red: the only accent */

  --font-display: var(--font-dela-gothic), "Arial Black", sans-serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-zen-kaku), system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-dm-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;

  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1);
}

:root {
  --gutter: clamp(16px, 4vw, 64px);
  --topbar: 72px;
  --rule: 3px solid var(--color-sumi);
  /* Board-marked concrete: horizontal formwork boards plus faint vertical grain. */
  --board-marks:
    repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 58px, color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-sumi) 14%, transparent) 58px 60px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 3px, color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-washi) 5%, transparent) 3px 4px, transparent 4px 11px);
}

html:has(.kj-body) {
  scroll-padding-top: var(--topbar);
}

/* ─────────────── Base ─────────────── */
.kj-body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--color-sumi);
  color: var(--color-washi);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.kj-body ::selection {
  background: var(--color-shu);
  color: var(--color-washi);
}

.kj-body :focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--color-shu);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.kj-mono {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin: 0;
}

.kj-shu {
  color: var(--color-shu);
}

.kj-h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 6rem);
  line-height: 0.95;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  margin: 0;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.kj-h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.2vw, 2.25rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
  margin: 0;
}

.kj-lead {
  font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1.3vw, 1.25rem);
  max-width: 48ch;
  margin: 0;
}

.kj-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 52px;
  padding: 0 26px;
  border: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background-color 160ms var(--ease-out),
    color 160ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 160ms var(--ease-out);
}

.kj-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.97);
}

.kj-btn--shu {
  background: var(--color-shu);
  color: var(--color-washi);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .kj-btn--shu:hover {
    background: var(--color-washi);
    color: var(--color-sumi);
  }
}

.kj-placeholder {
  display: grid;
  background: var(--board-marks), var(--color-shadow);
  border: 2px dashed color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-washi) 35%, transparent);
  color: var(--color-washi);
}

.kj-placeholder .kj-mono {
  align-self: start;
  justify-self: start;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  opacity: 0.75;
}

.kj-photo {
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.kj-photo img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

/* ─────────────── Top bar + noren ─────────────── */
.kj-topbar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 40;
  height: var(--topbar);
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding-left: var(--gutter);
  background: var(--color-sumi);
  border-bottom: var(--rule);
  border-bottom-color: var(--color-shadow);
}

.kj-topbar__brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  color: var(--color-washi);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.kj-noren {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 0 var(--gutter) 0 0;
}

.kj-noren__panel {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  align-content: end;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  width: clamp(44px, 9vw, 112px);
  padding: 0 4px 10px;
  background: var(--color-shadow);
  color: var(--color-washi);
  text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 4px solid var(--color-shu);
  transform-origin: top center;
  transition:
    background-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 260ms var(--ease-out);
}

.kj-noren__jp {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  line-height: 1;
}

.kj-noren__label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  display: none;
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .kj-noren__panel:hover {
    background: var(--color-shu);
    transform: translateY(4px);
  }
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .kj-noren__label {
    display: block;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 599px) {
  .kj-topbar__brand .kj-mono {
    display: none;
  }
  .kj-noren__panel {
    width: 52px;
  }
}

/* ─────────────── Hero ─────────────── */
.kj-hero {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--color-sumi);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.kj-hero__grid {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  gap: 32px;
  padding: 48px var(--gutter) 56px;
  min-height: calc(100svh - var(--topbar) - 56px);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.kj-hero__copy {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
  align-content: end;
  justify-items: start;
}

.kj-hero__kicker {
  color: var(--color-beton);
}

.kj-wordmark {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 0.8;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  margin: 0;
}

.kj-hero__wordmark {
  font-size: clamp(6rem, 21vw, 22rem); /* phones: as wide as the screen allows */
  color: var(--color-washi);
}

.kj-wordmark__o {
  color: var(--color-shu);
}

.kj-hero__lead {
  max-width: 34ch;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1.4vw, 1.3rem);
  color: var(--color-washi);
}

.kj-hero__dish {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  width: min(100%, 560px);
  justify-self: center;
}

.kj-dish-poster {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.kj-dish-poster img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.kj-hero__kanji {
  position: absolute;
  right: var(--gutter);
  top: 24px;
  margin: 0;
  writing-mode: vertical-rl;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(8rem, 24vw, 26rem);
  line-height: 1;
  color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-washi) 7%, var(--color-sumi));
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
}

.kj-signage {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 var(--gutter);
  min-height: 56px;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px 28px;
  background: var(--color-shu);
  color: var(--color-washi);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
}

.kj-signage li {
  padding: 16px 0;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .kj-hero__grid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(0, 0.85fr) auto;
    align-items: end;
    column-gap: clamp(24px, 3vw, 48px);
  }
  .kj-hero__wordmark {
    font-size: clamp(6rem, 13.5vw, 14rem);
  }
  .kj-hero__dish {
    align-self: center;
  }
  /* Desktop: the vertical 麹 becomes its own column beside the dish. */
  .kj-hero__kanji {
    position: static;
    align-self: start;
    font-size: clamp(6rem, 10vw, 11rem);
    color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-washi) 14%, var(--color-sumi));
  }
}


/* ─────────────── Hero dish: poster, then the real-time canvas ─────────────── */
.kj-dish {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.kj-dish__poster,
.kj-dish__canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.kj-dish__poster {
  transition: opacity 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.kj-dish__canvas {
  opacity: 0;
  cursor: grab;
  touch-action: pan-y;
  transition: opacity 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.kj-dish__canvas:active {
  cursor: grabbing;
}

.kj-dish[data-ready] .kj-dish__canvas {
  opacity: 1;
}

.kj-dish[data-ready] .kj-dish__poster {
  opacity: 0;
}

.kj-dish__start {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 16px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.kj-dish__start:active {
  transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.97);
}

.kj-dish__hint {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: -28px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--color-beton);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 400ms var(--ease-out) 600ms;
}

.kj-dish[data-ready] .kj-dish__start {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 16px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.kj-dish__start:active {
  transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.97);
}

.kj-dish__hint {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* ─────────────── Slabs ─────────────── */
.kj-slab {
  position: relative;
  padding: clamp(64px, 9vw, 128px) var(--gutter);
  border-top: var(--rule);
}

.kj-slab--beton {
  background: var(--board-marks), var(--color-beton);
  color: var(--color-sumi);
}

.kj-slab--sumi {
  background: var(--color-sumi);
  color: var(--color-washi);
  border-top-color: var(--color-shadow);
}

.kj-slab--washi {
  background: var(--color-washi);
  color: var(--color-sumi);
}

.kj-section-head {
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px);
}

/* Kitchen */
.kj-pillars {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0 0 48px;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  border-top: var(--rule);
}

.kj-pillar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  column-gap: 20px;
  row-gap: 6px;
  padding: 28px 0;
  border-bottom: var(--rule);
}

.kj-pillar__kanji {
  grid-row: span 2;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5.5rem);
  line-height: 1;
  min-width: 1.2em;
}

.kj-pillar p {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 44ch;
}

.kj-kitchen__photos {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.kj-photo--wide {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
}

.kj-photo--tall {
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
}

.kj-photo--square {
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  max-width: 280px;
}

/* Omakase */
.kj-omakase {
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px);
  padding-top: clamp(48px, 6vw, 80px);
  padding-bottom: clamp(48px, 6vw, 80px);
}

.kj-omakase .kj-section-head {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.kj-flight-slot {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
}

.kj-menu {
  border: 2px solid var(--color-shadow);
  padding: 24px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
  align-content: start;
  align-self: start;
}

.kj-menu__head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  color: var(--color-beton);
}

.kj-menu__groups,
.kj-menu__courses {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.kj-menu__group {
  padding: 14px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-shadow);
  transition: color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.kj-menu__group[data-active] {
  color: var(--color-washi);
}

.kj-menu__group[data-active] .kj-menu__group-name {
  color: var(--color-shu);
}

.kj-menu__group-name {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
}

.kj-menu__courses li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2.5ch 7.5rem 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 4px 0;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.kj-menu__n {
  color: var(--color-shu);
}

.kj-menu__detail {
  color: var(--color-beton);
}


/* ─────────────── Food flight ─────────────── */
/* Static sequence: before clips exist, and under reduced motion. */
.kj-flight-static {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  background: var(--color-shadow);
  border: 2px solid var(--color-shadow);
}

.kj-flight-static__scene {
  display: grid;
  background: var(--color-sumi);
}

.kj-flight-static__still {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
}

.kj-flight-static__copy {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 16px 20px 20px;
}

.kj-flight-static__copy .kj-mono {
  color: var(--color-shu);
}

.kj-flight-static__copy p:last-child {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-beton);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
}

/* Scrubbed flight: a tall track with a sticky, transformed stage the engine's fixed layers pin to. */
.kj-flight {
  position: relative;
  height: calc(var(--flight-height) * 100vh);
}

.kj-flight__sticky {
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--topbar);
  height: calc(100vh - var(--topbar));
  overflow: hidden;
  transform: translateZ(0); /* makes position: fixed children relative to this box */
}

.kj-flight__engine {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  /* scroll-world theme */
  --sw-bg: var(--color-sumi);
  --sw-ink: var(--color-washi);
  --sw-ink-soft: var(--color-beton);
  --sw-accent: var(--color-shu);
  --sw-font-display: var(--font-display);
  --sw-font-body: var(--font-body);
}

.kj-flight__engine .sw-route__label {
  background: var(--color-washi);
  color: var(--color-sumi);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.kj-flight__engine .sw-track,
.kj-flight__engine .sw-scrollbar,
.kj-flight__engine .sw-topbar {
  display: none;
}

.kj-slabwipe {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 200;
  background: var(--board-marks), var(--color-shadow);
  transform: translateX(-101%);
  animation: kj-slab 450ms var(--ease-in-out) forwards;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes kj-slab {
  0% {
    transform: translateX(-101%);
  }
  45%,
  55% {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translateX(101%);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .kj-slabwipe {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* Building */
.kj-building {
  display: grid;
  gap: 40px;
}

.kj-building__photo {
  aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
}

.kj-building__copy {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
  align-content: start;
}

.kj-facts {
  margin: 0;
  display: grid;
  border-top: var(--rule);
}

.kj-facts > div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 12px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-beton);
}

.kj-facts dd {
  margin: 0;
  text-align: right;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Chef */
.kj-chef {
  display: grid;
  gap: 40px;
}

.kj-chef__copy {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
  align-content: center;
}

.kj-quote {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 20px;
  border-left: 6px solid var(--color-shu);
}

.kj-quote p {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2.5rem);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.kj-chef__bio {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-beton);
  max-width: 48ch;
}

.kj-chef__photo {
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
}

/* Reservation */
.kj-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
  max-width: 920px;
  padding: 28px;
  background: var(--color-washi);
  border: var(--rule);
  box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 var(--color-sumi);
  color: var(--color-sumi);
}

.kj-form--held {
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 220px;
  align-content: center;
}

.kj-form__row {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.kj-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.kj-field input,
.kj-field select {
  height: 52px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-sumi);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: var(--color-washi);
  color: var(--color-sumi);
  font: inherit;
  min-width: 0;
}

.kj-field input:focus-visible,
.kj-field select:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--color-shu);
  outline-offset: 0;
}

.kj-field[data-invalid] input,
.kj-field[data-invalid] select {
  border-color: var(--color-shu);
}

.kj-field__error {
  color: var(--color-shu);
}

.kj-form .kj-btn {
  justify-self: start;
}

/* Footer */
.kj-footer {
  display: grid;
  gap: 32px;
  padding: 56px var(--gutter);
  background: var(--color-sumi);
  border-top: var(--rule);
  border-top-color: var(--color-shu);
}

.kj-footer__brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
}

.kj-footer__wordmark {
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem);
}

.kj-footer__info {
  margin: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.kj-footer__info dt {
  color: var(--color-beton);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.kj-footer__info dd {
  margin: 0;
}

.kj-footer__legal {
  color: var(--color-shadow);
}

.kj-visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .kj-pillars {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    border-top: 0;
  }
  .kj-pillar {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    border-top: var(--rule);
    border-bottom: 0;
    padding-right: 24px;
  }
  .kj-pillar__kanji {
    grid-row: auto;
  }
  .kj-kitchen__photos {
    grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr;
    align-items: end;
  }
  .kj-omakase {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    column-gap: 32px;
  }
  .kj-omakase .kj-section-head {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
  .kj-omakase__flight:has([data-flight="scrub"]) {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
  .kj-omakase:has([data-flight="scrub"]) .kj-menu {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    max-width: 920px;
    width: 100%;
    margin-inline: auto;
  }
  .kj-omakase:has([data-flight="static"]) .kj-menu {
    position: sticky;
    top: calc(var(--topbar) + 24px);
  }
  .kj-building {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.85fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr);
    column-gap: clamp(32px, 5vw, 80px);
  }
  .kj-chef {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 0.9fr);
    column-gap: clamp(32px, 5vw, 80px);
  }
  .kj-form__row {
    grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 0.8fr;
  }
  .kj-form__row--two {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
  .kj-footer {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
    align-items: end;
  }
  .kj-footer__info {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }
  .kj-footer__legal {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
}
]]>
    </file>

    <file path="src/app/(koji)/koji/dish/capabilities.ts">
<![CDATA[export type RenderMode = "webgpu" | "webgl2" | "poster";
export type RenderEnv = { reducedMotion: boolean; webgpu: boolean; webgl2: boolean };

/** Reduced motion or no GPU path → static poster; otherwise WebGPU, falling back to WebGL2. */
export function pickRenderMode(env: RenderEnv): RenderMode {
  if (env.reducedMotion) return "poster";
  if (env.webgpu) return "webgpu";
  if (env.webgl2) return "webgl2";
  return "poster";
}

/** Reads the browser's capabilities. WebGPU needs an adapter, not just `navigator.gpu`. */
export async function detectEnv(): Promise<RenderEnv> {
  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  let webgpu = false;
  try {
    const gpu = (navigator as Navigator & { gpu?: { requestAdapter: () => Promise<unknown> } }).gpu;
    webgpu = Boolean(gpu && (await gpu.requestAdapter()));
  } catch {
    webgpu = false;
  }
  let webgl2 = false;
  try {
    webgl2 = Boolean(document.createElement("canvas").getContext("webgl2"));
  } catch {
    webgl2 = false;
  }
  return { reducedMotion, webgpu, webgl2 };
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(koji)/koji/dish/createDishScene.ts">
<![CDATA[import * as THREE from "three/webgpu";
import { buildNigiri } from "./nigiri";

const AUTO_SPIN = 0.15; // rad/s
const DAMPING = 0.92; // per frame, for drag inertia
const MAX_TILT = 0.28;

export type DishScene = { dispose(): void };

/**
 * Real-time miso-glazed nigiri. WebGPU when available, WebGL2 otherwise (`forceWebGL`).
 * Turns slowly, can be dragged with inertia, pauses off-screen, and calls `onLost` if the GPU device is lost.
 */
export async function createDishScene(
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  opts: { forceWebGL: boolean; onReady(): void; onLost(): void },
): Promise<DishScene> {
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGPURenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, alpha: true, forceWebGL: opts.forceWebGL });
  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
  renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);
  renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
  renderer.toneMappingExposure = 0.9;
  renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
  renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFShadowMap;
  await renderer.init();
  renderer.onDeviceLost = () => opts.onLost();

  // No environment map: PMREM generation is the single most expensive start-up step. A soft fill light
  // above and the clearcoat's direct highlights carry the glaze instead.
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();

  // Low raking key light from the left, like late sun across the counter.
  const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe2c0, 4.2);
  key.position.set(-3.6, 3.2, 2.6);
  key.castShadow = true;
  key.shadow.mapSize.set(768, 768);
  key.shadow.camera.left = -3;
  key.shadow.camera.right = 3;
  key.shadow.camera.top = 3;
  key.shadow.camera.bottom = -3;
  key.shadow.radius = 6;
  key.shadow.bias = -0.0005;
  scene.add(key);
  // Cool rim from behind to lift the silhouette off the dark page.
  const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xc9d4ff, 1.6);
  rim.position.set(2.5, 2.5, -4);
  scene.add(rim);
  scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff1e0, 0x1a1918, 0.6));
  const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4e6, 0.9); // soft top fill for the glaze highlight
  fill.position.set(0.5, 5, 3);
  scene.add(fill);

  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(28, 1, 0.1, 50);
  camera.position.set(0, 2.25, 5.6);
  camera.lookAt(0, 0.05, 0);

  const dish = buildNigiri();
  scene.add(dish);

  // Size to the canvas box.
  const resize = () => {
    const { clientWidth: w, clientHeight: h } = canvas;
    if (!w || !h) return;
    renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
    camera.aspect = w / h;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  };
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize);
  ro.observe(canvas);
  resize();

  // Drag to rotate, with inertia.
  let velocity = 0;
  let tilt = 0;
  let dragging = false;
  let lastX = 0;
  let lastY = 0;
  const onDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    dragging = true;
    lastX = e.clientX;
    lastY = e.clientY;
    canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  };
  const onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - lastX;
    const dy = e.clientY - lastY;
    lastX = e.clientX;
    lastY = e.clientY;
    velocity = dx * 0.0065;
    dish.rotation.y += velocity;
    tilt = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(tilt + dy * 0.004, -MAX_TILT, MAX_TILT);
  };
  const onUp = () => {
    dragging = false;
  };
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
  canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);

  // Only render while visible.
  let visible = true;
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
    visible = entry.isIntersecting;
  });
  io.observe(canvas);

  const timer = new THREE.Timer();
  let readySent = false;
  renderer.setAnimationLoop((time) => {
    timer.update(time);
    const dt = Math.min(timer.getDelta(), 0.05);
    if (!visible || document.hidden) return;
    if (!dragging) {
      velocity *= DAMPING;
      dish.rotation.y += velocity + AUTO_SPIN * dt;
      tilt *= 0.96;
    }
    dish.rotation.x = tilt;
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    if (!readySent) {
      readySent = true;
      opts.onReady();
    }
  });

  return {
    dispose() {
      renderer.setAnimationLoop(null);
      timer.dispose();
      ro.disconnect();
      io.disconnect();
      canvas.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
      canvas.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      canvas.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
      canvas.removeEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);
      dish.traverse((o) => {
        const mesh = o as THREE.Mesh;
        mesh.geometry?.dispose();
        const mat = mesh.material as THREE.Material | THREE.Material[] | undefined;
        (Array.isArray(mat) ? mat : mat ? [mat] : []).forEach((x) => x.dispose());
      });
      renderer.dispose();
    },
  };
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(koji)/koji/dish/HeroDish.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { detectEnv, pickRenderMode, type RenderMode } from "./capabilities";

/** Phones, touch screens and data-saver connections get 3D on request, so it never competes with first paint. */
function shouldAutoStart(): boolean {
  const coarse = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches;
  const saveData = (navigator as Navigator & { connection?: { saveData?: boolean } }).connection?.saveData;
  return !coarse && !saveData && window.innerWidth >= 900;
}

/** Resolves once the page has loaded and the main thread has a quiet moment. */
function afterIdle(): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const idle = () =>
      "requestIdleCallback" in window ? window.requestIdleCallback(() => resolve(), { timeout: 2500 }) : setTimeout(resolve, 600);
    if (document.readyState === "complete") idle();
    else window.addEventListener("load", idle, { once: true });
  });
}

/**
 * The hero dish. Shows `poster` first. On desktop it lazy-loads the Three.js scene (WebGPU, or WebGL2 as a
 * fallback) once the page is idle; on phones a "View the dish in 3D" button loads it on request. The canvas
 * fades in over 400 ms. Reduced motion, no GPU, or a lost device keep the poster.
 */
export function HeroDish({ poster }: { poster: ReactNode }) {
  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<RenderMode | "pending">("pending");
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [requested, setRequested] = useState<"auto" | "wait" | "go" | null>(null);

  // Decide the render mode once, on the client.
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    detectEnv().then((env) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      setMode(pickRenderMode(env));
      setRequested(shouldAutoStart() ? "auto" : "wait");
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  // Load and start the scene when the dish comes near the viewport.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== "webgpu" && mode !== "webgl2") return;
    if (requested !== "auto" && requested !== "go") return;
    const wrap = wrapRef.current;
    if (!wrap) return;
    let scene: { dispose(): void } | undefined;
    let cancelled = false;

    const start = async () => {
      const { createDishScene } = await import("./createDishScene");
      if (cancelled || !canvasRef.current) return;
      try {
        scene = await createDishScene(canvasRef.current, {
          forceWebGL: mode === "webgl2",
          onReady: () => !cancelled && setReady(true),
          onLost: () => {
            scene?.dispose();
            scene = undefined;
            if (!cancelled) setMode("poster");
          },
        });
        if (cancelled) scene.dispose();
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setMode("poster");
      }
    };

    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          io.disconnect();
          // Auto-start waits for an idle main thread; a tap starts immediately.
          (requested === "auto" ? afterIdle() : Promise.resolve()).then(() => {
            if (!cancelled) void start();
          });
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: "200px" },
    );
    io.observe(wrap);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      io.disconnect();
      scene?.dispose();
    };
  }, [mode, requested]);

  const gpu = mode === "webgpu" || mode === "webgl2";
  const showCanvas = gpu && (requested === "auto" || requested === "go");
  return (
    <div ref={wrapRef} className="kj-dish" data-mode={mode} data-ready={ready ? "" : undefined}>
      <div className="kj-dish__poster">{poster}</div>
      {showCanvas ? (
        <canvas
          ref={canvasRef}
          className="kj-dish__canvas"
          data-ready={ready ? "true" : "false"}
          aria-label="A piece of miso-glazed nigiri, slowly turning. Drag to rotate."
          role="img"
        />
      ) : null}
      {showCanvas ? (
        <p className="kj-mono kj-dish__hint" aria-hidden="true">
          Drag to turn the plate
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {gpu && requested === "wait" ? (
        <button type="button" className="kj-btn kj-btn--shu kj-dish__start" onClick={() => setRequested("go")}>
          View the dish in 3D
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(koji)/koji/dish/materials.ts">
<![CDATA[import * as THREE from "three/webgpu";
import {
  color,
  float,
  mix,
  mx_fractal_noise_float,
  mx_noise_float,
  positionLocal,
  positionWorld,
  smoothstep,
  vec3,
} from "three/tsl";

/*
 * Procedural materials for the miso-glazed nigiri. Food colours are content, not brand UI, so this folder
 * is exempt from KŌJI's five-colour palette (see scripts/templates.config.ts).
 */

/** Hand-pressed rice grains: warm off-white, matte, each grain slightly different. */
export function riceMaterial(): THREE.MeshStandardNodeMaterial {
  const m = new THREE.MeshStandardNodeMaterial();
  const variation = mx_noise_float(positionWorld.mul(9.0)).mul(0.5).add(0.5);
  m.colorNode = mix(color("#e6d9be"), color("#f4ecdc"), variation);
  m.roughnessNode = float(0.5);
  m.metalnessNode = float(0.0);
  return m;
}

/** The rice bed under the grains: same colour family, rougher, lightly lumpy. */
export function riceBedMaterial(): THREE.MeshStandardNodeMaterial {
  const m = new THREE.MeshStandardNodeMaterial();
  const lumps = mx_fractal_noise_float(positionLocal.mul(6.0), 3, 2.0, 0.5);
  m.colorNode = mix(color("#e6dcc6"), color("#f5eedf"), lumps.mul(0.5).add(0.5));
  m.positionNode = positionLocal.add(positionLocal.normalize().mul(lumps.mul(0.025)));
  m.roughnessNode = float(0.8);
  return m;
}

/**
 * Fatty fish under a miso glaze: rose flesh with diagonal white fat marbling, an amber lacquer that
 * deepens toward the torched edges, and a glossy clearcoat that catches the raking light.
 */
export function fishMaterial(): THREE.MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial {
  const m = new THREE.MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial();
  const p = positionLocal;

  // Marbling: wavy diagonal bands, broken up with noise so they read as fat, not stripes.
  const wobble = mx_noise_float(p.mul(vec3(2.0, 4.0, 3.0))).mul(0.9);
  const bands = p.x.mul(7.5).add(p.z.mul(5.0)).add(wobble).sin().mul(0.5).add(0.5);
  const fat = smoothstep(0.8, 0.95, bands);

  const flesh = mix(color("#8a2a1c"), color("#b44a2e"), mx_noise_float(p.mul(5.0)).mul(0.5).add(0.5));
  const marbled = mix(flesh, color("#e9b896"), fat.mul(0.75));

  // Glaze: amber lacquer over the top surface, caramelised toward the torched ends.
  const topness = smoothstep(0.0, 0.1, p.y);
  const edge = smoothstep(0.55, 1.0, p.x.abs());
  const char = smoothstep(0.55, 0.95, mx_fractal_noise_float(p.mul(6.0), 3, 2.0, 0.5).mul(0.6).add(edge.mul(0.9)));
  const glazed = mix(marbled, color("#8f4513"), topness.mul(0.45));
  m.colorNode = mix(glazed, color("#3e1d0e"), char.mul(topness).mul(0.6));

  m.roughnessNode = mix(float(0.42), float(0.24), topness);
  m.clearcoatNode = topness;
  m.clearcoatRoughnessNode = float(0.08);
  return m;
}

/** Dark speckled stoneware: near-black ash glaze with pale iron speckles, very matte. */
export function stonewareMaterial(): THREE.MeshStandardNodeMaterial {
  const m = new THREE.MeshStandardNodeMaterial();
  const p = positionLocal.mul(14.0);
  const speckle = smoothstep(0.82, 0.9, mx_noise_float(p).mul(0.5).add(0.5));
  const glaze = mix(color("#1d1b19"), color("#2c2824"), mx_fractal_noise_float(positionLocal.mul(2.5), 3, 2.0, 0.5).mul(0.5).add(0.5));
  m.colorNode = mix(glaze, color("#8f877a"), speckle.mul(0.6));
  m.roughnessNode = float(0.86);
  return m;
}

<![CDATA[import * as THREE from "three/webgpu";
import { fishMaterial, riceBedMaterial, riceMaterial, stonewareMaterial } from "./materials";

const GRAINS = 680;

/** Deterministic pseudo-random numbers, so the dish looks the same on every load. */
function rng(seed: number) {
  let s = seed;
  return () => {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647;
    return (s - 1) / 2147483646;
  };
}

/** The rice: an oblong pressed mound plus instanced grains scattered over its upper surface. */
function rice(): THREE.Group {
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  const rx = 1.05;
  const ry = 0.42;
  const rz = 0.52;

  const bed = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 64, 32), riceBedMaterial());
  bed.scale.set(rx * 0.97, ry * 0.97, rz * 0.97);
  bed.castShadow = true;
  bed.receiveShadow = true;
  group.add(bed);

  const grainGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.04, 0.055, 3, 8);
  const grains = new THREE.InstancedMesh(grainGeo, riceMaterial(), GRAINS);
  grains.castShadow = true;
  const random = rng(19721972);
  const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
  const q = new THREE.Quaternion();
  const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  const n = new THREE.Vector3();
  const tangent = new THREE.Vector3();
  for (let i = 0; i < GRAINS; i++) {
    // Sample the ellipsoid surface, biased to the visible upper and side areas.
    const theta = random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const phi = Math.acos(1 - random() * 1.35); // 0 (top) … ~110° (just past the equator)
    const x = Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta);
    const y = Math.cos(phi);
    const z = Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta);
    const pos = new THREE.Vector3(x * rx, y * ry, z * rz);
    n.set(x / rx, y / ry, z / rz).normalize();
    // Lay each grain flat on the surface, pointing in a random tangent direction.
    tangent.set(random() - 0.5, 0, random() - 0.5).normalize().projectOnPlane(n).normalize();
    q.setFromUnitVectors(up, tangent);
    const s = 0.8 + random() * 0.3;
    m.compose(pos.addScaledVector(n, 0.012), q, new THREE.Vector3(s, s, s));
    grains.setMatrixAt(i, m);
  }
  group.add(grains);
  return group;
}

/** The fish: a thick slab draped over the rice, ends drooping, edges softly rounded. */
function fish(): THREE.Mesh {
  const halfX = 1.18;
  const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(halfX * 2, 0.13, 1.12, 64, 3, 28);
  const pos = geo.attributes.position as THREE.BufferAttribute;
  for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
    const x = pos.getX(i);
    const y = pos.getY(i);
    const z = pos.getZ(i);
    const u = x / halfX; // -1 … 1 along the length
    const w = z / 0.56; // -1 … 1 across
    // Drape: highest over the middle of the rice, drooping at both ends.
    const drape = 0.34 - 0.4 * u * u * u * u - 0.1 * u * u;
    // Narrow the ends a little and round the long edges down.
    const taper = 1 - 0.18 * u * u;
    const sag = -0.05 * w * w;
    pos.setXYZ(i, x, y + drape + sag, z * taper);
  }
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, fishMaterial());
  mesh.position.y = 0.16;
  mesh.rotation.y = 0.04;
  mesh.castShadow = true;
  mesh.receiveShadow = true;
  return mesh;
}

/** The plate: a heavy rectangular stoneware board with a slightly raised rim. */
function plate(): THREE.Mesh {
  const shape = new THREE.Shape();
  const w = 1.9;
  const d = 1.15;
  const r = 0.22;
  shape.moveTo(-w + r, -d);
  shape.lineTo(w - r, -d);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(w, -d, w, -d + r);
  shape.lineTo(w, d - r);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(w, d, w - r, d);
  shape.lineTo(-w + r, d);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(-w, d, -w, d - r);
  shape.lineTo(-w, -d + r);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(-w, -d, -w + r, -d);
  const geo = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {
    depth: 0.16,
    bevelEnabled: true,
    bevelThickness: 0.05,
    bevelSize: 0.05,
    bevelSegments: 4,
    curveSegments: 16,
  });
  geo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, stonewareMaterial());
  mesh.position.y = -0.62;
  mesh.receiveShadow = true;
  return mesh;
}

/** One piece of miso-glazed nigiri on its plate, centred at the origin. */
export function buildNigiri(): THREE.Group {
  const dish = new THREE.Group();
  const piece = new THREE.Group();
  const r = rice();
  r.position.y = 0.0; // rests on the plate top at y = -0.41
  piece.add(r, fish());
  dish.add(plate(), piece);
  return dish;
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import { COURSE_GROUPS, type CourseGroupId } from "../menu";

export type Seam = "clip" | "slabWipe";

export type Flight = {
  sections: { id: CourseGroupId; label: string; jp: string; courses: readonly { n: number; name: string; detail: string }[] }[];
  /** One per join between scenes. "slabWipe" = no connector clip; a concrete panel sweeps across the cut. */
  seams: Seam[];
};

/** Viewport-heights of scroll per clip (scroll-world defaults). */
export const DIVE_SCROLL = 1.3;
export const CONN_SCROLL = 0.9;

export const FLIGHT: Flight = {
  sections: COURSE_GROUPS.map((g) => ({ id: g.id, label: g.label, jp: g.jp, courses: g.courses })),
  // Set a seam to "slabWipe" when its connector can't pass scripts/seam-check.sh.
  seams: ["clip", "clip", "clip", "clip"],
};

export type EngineSection = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  still: string;
  clip: string;
  /** 720p, tighter-GOP encode the engine loads on phones. */
  clipMobile: string;
  eyebrow: string;
  title: string;
  body: string;
  accent: string;
};

export type EngineConfig = {
  sections: EngineSection[];
  connectors: (string | null)[];
  connectorsMobile: (string | null)[];
  diveScroll: number;
  connScroll: number;
  nav: false;
  atmosphere: false;
  hint: string;
};

/** Maps the flight to scroll-world's `mountScrollWorld` config. Slab-wipe seams become null connectors. */
export function toEngineConfig(f: Flight, base: string, stillBase = "/templates/koji"): EngineConfig {
  const uniqueNames = (s: Flight["sections"][number]) => Array.from(new Set(s.courses.map((c) => c.name)));
  return {
    sections: f.sections.map((s, i) => ({
      id: s.id,
      label: s.label,
      still: `${stillBase}/flight-${s.id}-1600.webp`,
      clip: `${base}/dive-${i + 1}.mp4`,
      clipMobile: `${base}/dive-${i + 1}-m.mp4`,
      eyebrow: `${s.jp} · Courses ${s.courses.map((c) => String(c.n).padStart(2, "0")).join(", ")}`,
      title: uniqueNames(s).join(" · "),
      body: s.courses.map((c) => c.detail).join(" / "),
      accent: "var(--color-shu)",
    })),
    connectors: f.seams.map((seam, i) => (seam === "clip" ? `${base}/conn-${i + 1}-${i + 2}.mp4` : null)),
    connectorsMobile: f.seams.map((seam, i) => (seam === "clip" ? `${base}/conn-${i + 1}-${i + 2}-m.mp4` : null)),
    diveScroll: DIVE_SCROLL,
    connScroll: CONN_SCROLL,
    nav: false,
    atmosphere: false,
    hint: "Scroll through the courses",
  };
}

/** Total scroll height of the flight in viewport-heights (the engine adds one viewport so the last clip completes). */
export function flightHeightVh(f: Flight): number {
  const conns = f.seams.filter((s) => s === "clip").length;
  return f.sections.length * DIVE_SCROLL + conns * CONN_SCROLL + 1;
}

/** Where each slab-wipe cut happens, in viewport-heights from the top of the flight. */
export function seamOffsetsVh(f: Flight): number[] {
  const offsets: number[] = [];
  let y = 0;
  f.sections.forEach((_, i) => {
    y += DIVE_SCROLL;
    const seam = f.seams[i];
    if (seam === "clip") y += CONN_SCROLL;
    else if (seam === "slabWipe") offsets.push(Math.round(y * 1000) / 1000);
  });
  return offsets;
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Picture } from "../assets";
import { CLIPS } from "./clips.generated";
import { FLIGHT, flightHeightVh, seamOffsetsVh, toEngineConfig, type Flight } from "./flight.config";
import { SlabWipe } from "./SlabWipe";

const CLIP_BASE = "/templates/koji/clips";

/** Seams whose connector clip is missing fall back to a slab wipe automatically. */
function effectiveFlight(): Flight {
  return { ...FLIGHT, seams: FLIGHT.seams.map((s, i) => (s === "clip" && CLIPS.connectors[i] ? "clip" : "slabWipe")) };
}

const ALL_DIVES = CLIPS.dives.every(Boolean);

/** The five scenes as a still sequence: used before clips exist and under reduced motion. */
function StaticFlight() {
  return (
    <ol className="kj-flight-static" data-flight="static">
      {FLIGHT.sections.map((s, i) => (
        <li key={s.id} className="kj-flight-static__scene">
          <Picture
            assetKey={`flight-${s.id}`}
            alt={`${s.label}: ${s.courses.map((c) => c.detail).join(", ")}`}
            className="kj-photo kj-flight-static__still"
            sizes="(min-width: 900px) 60vw, 100vw"
          />
          <div className="kj-flight-static__copy">
            <p className="kj-mono">
              {String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")} / 05 · {s.jp}
            </p>
            <h3 className="kj-h3">{s.label}</h3>
            <p>{s.courses.map((c) => c.detail).join(" / ")}</p>
          </div>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

/**
 * The scroll-scrubbed food flight (scroll-world engine). Its fixed layers are pinned to a sticky,
 * transformed box, and it measures scroll from the flight's own top.
 */
function ScrubFlight() {
  const outerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const flight = useMemo(effectiveFlight, []);
  const wipes = useMemo(() => seamOffsetsVh(flight), [flight]);
  const [wipeKey, setWipeKey] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const outer = outerRef.current;
    const mount = mountRef.current;
    if (!outer || !mount || mount.dataset.mounted) return;
    mount.dataset.mounted = "true";

    const topbar = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--topbar")) || 72;
    const originY = () => outer.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - topbar;
    const scrollY = () => window.scrollY - originY();

    // The engine fetches every clip on mount, so it waits until the flight is a viewport away;
    // the hero then paints without competing for bandwidth.
    const near = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (!entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting)) return;
        near.disconnect();
        import("./scrub-engine.js").then(({ mountScrollWorld }) => {
          mountScrollWorld(mount, { ...toEngineConfig(flight, CLIP_BASE), scrollY, originY });
        }).catch(() => {});
      },
      { rootMargin: "100% 0px" },
    );
    near.observe(outer);

    // Slab wipes: replay whenever the scroll position crosses a cut, in either direction.
    let last = scrollY() / window.innerHeight;
    const onScroll = () => {
      const now = scrollY() / window.innerHeight;
      if (wipes.some((w) => (last < w && now >= w) || (last >= w && now < w))) setWipeKey((k) => k + 1);
      last = now;
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      delete mount.dataset.mounted;
      near.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
    };
  }, [flight, wipes]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={outerRef}
      className="kj-flight"
      data-flight="scrub"
      style={{ "--flight-height": flightHeightVh(flight) } as React.CSSProperties}
    >
      <div className="kj-flight__sticky">
        <div ref={mountRef} className="kj-flight__engine" />
        <SlabWipe playKey={wipeKey} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Scrubbed video when all five dives exist and motion is allowed; otherwise the still sequence.
 * The still sequence renders until reduced motion is known, so the engine never mounts for visitors who
 * asked for less motion.
 */
export function FoodFlight() {
  const [scrub, setScrub] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    setScrub(ALL_DIVES && !window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches);
  }, []);
  return scrub ? <ScrubFlight /> : <StaticFlight />;
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(koji)/koji/flight/scrub-engine.js">
<![CDATA[/* KŌJI vendored copy of scroll-world's scrub engine — https://github.com/oso95/scroll-world (MIT).
   Four KŌJI patches, each marked "KŌJI patch":
     1. config.scrollY() — scroll position measured from the flight's own top, so the engine can live
        mid-page instead of owning the whole document.
     2. config.originY() — added to jumpTo() targets for the same reason.
     3. Dropped the injected html,body{overflow-x:hidden} rule, which broke position: sticky on the host page.
     4. Route dots carry an aria-label: their visible label is display:none on phones, leaving unnamed buttons.
   The engine's fixed layers are pinned to a sticky, transformed wrapper (see FoodFlight.tsx), and its
   theme comes from --sw-* custom properties set in koji.css. */
/* ============================================================================
   scroll-world — portable scroll-scrubbed camera-flight engine
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Framework-agnostic. Vanilla JS, zero dependencies. It builds its own DOM and
   injects its own (namespaced) CSS into a container you give it, so it drops into
   plain HTML, Next.js (call from a ref/useEffect), Vue (onMounted), a server-
   rendered page, anything.

   USAGE
     mountScrollWorld(document.getElementById('world'), {
       brand: { name: 'Pearl & Co.', href: '#top' },
       diveScroll: 1.3,   // viewport-heights of scroll per dive clip
       connScroll: 0.9,   // ...per connector clip
       hint: 'scroll to fly in',
       nav: true,         // show the top section nav
       atmosphere: true,  // subtle gradient + drifting particles behind the clips
       sections: [
         { id, label, still, stillMobile, clip, clipMobile, accent,
           scroll: 1.6,   // optional per-section override of diveScroll — more scroll
                          // distance = a slower, longer dwell in this scene
           linger: 0.5,   // optional 0..1 — remaps time so the camera settles mid-scene
                          // (exactly where the copy peaks) and moves quicker at the
                          // edges. 0 = linear (default). Keep ≤ 0.6; 1 = full pause.
           eyebrow, title, body, tags:[…],
           cta:{ primary:{label,href}, secondary:{label,href} } }, // last section only
         …
       ],
       connectors: [clipUrl, …],          // length = sections.length - 1 (nulls allowed)
       connectorsMobile: [clipUrl, …],    // optional lighter connectors for phones (same length)

   MOBILE (the clipMobile/connectorsMobile variants are the opt-in mobile version;
   the rest of the phone handling below is always on)
     The engine is phone-aware out of the box: on a coarse-pointer / ≤860px viewport it
       - loads `clipMobile` / `connectorsMobile` when provided (encode these smaller +
         tighter-GOP — seek cost on a phone decoder is dominated by frames-from-keyframe,
         so a 720p, -g 4 file scrubs far smoother than the 1080p desktop master; see
         pipeline.md). Falls back to the desktop `clip` if no mobile variant is given.
       - uses `stillMobile` as the scene poster when provided (pair it with native 9:16
         clipMobile renders so the poster matches the portrait video's first frame instead
         of flashing from a landscape crop). Chosen once at mount; a desktop resize into
         phone width keeps the desktop poster (clips still switch via isMobile()).
       - coalesces seeks (never issues a new currentTime while the decoder is still
         `seeking`) so fast flicks can't pile up and freeze the video.
       - keeps the still as a live poster until the clip actually paints its first frame,
         and primes each video (muted play→pause) on first touch — this is what stops iOS
         from showing a blank scene before the first seek.
       - drops the drifting particles and ignores URL-bar-only resizes (no scroll jump).
     Nothing here is required — a config with only `clip`/`connectors` still works on
     phones; the mobile variants just make it lighter and smoother.

   THEME (CSS custom properties; set on the container or :root to override)
     --sw-bg         page background (match your scene bg for seamless posters)
     --sw-ink        primary text
     --sw-ink-soft   secondary text
     --sw-accent     default accent (each section overrides via its `accent`)
     --sw-font-display / --sw-font-body

   REQUIREMENTS ON YOUR ASSETS
     - clips encoded native-res, crf~20, -g 8, +faststart, no audio (see pipeline.md)
     - connectors' endpoints are the neighbouring dives' ACTUAL frames (see SKILL Step 5)
     - (optional) mobile variants at ~720p, -g 4 for smoother phone scrubbing
   The engine loads each clip as a Blob (always seekable) and scrubs currentTime; it does
   NOT depend on HTTP byte-range support.
   ========================================================================== */

function mountScrollWorld(container, config) {
  const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  // Phone detection. `coarse` is captured once (input type doesn't change mid-session);
  // the ≤860px query is read live via isMobile() so a desktop resize/DevTools toggle
  // switches sources and seek behaviour without a reload.
  const coarse = window.matchMedia('(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)').matches;
  const smallMQ = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 860px)');
  const isMobile = () => coarse || smallMQ.matches;
  const SECTIONS = config.sections || [];
  const CONNECTORS = config.connectors || [];
  const CONNECTORS_M = config.connectorsMobile || [];
  const DIVE_W = config.diveScroll || 1.3;
  const CONN_W = config.connScroll || 0.9;
  const CROSSFADE = (config.crossfade != null) ? config.crossfade : 0.12;  // seam dissolve width (vh)
  const N = SECTIONS.length;
  if (!N) return;

  injectCSS();
  container.classList.add('sw-root');

  // ---- build the interleaved segment chain: dive0, conn0, dive1, … diveN-1 ----
  const SEGMENTS = [];
  SECTIONS.forEach((s, i) => {
    const dive = { kind: 'dive', si: i, clip: s.clip, clipM: s.clipMobile, still: s.still, stillM: s.stillMobile,
                   accent: s.accent, w: s.scroll || DIVE_W, linger: s.linger || 0 };
    SEGMENTS.push(dive);
    s._seg = dive;
    // A connector is optional: if connectors[i] is falsy, the two dives simply
    // crossfade directly (no fly-over). Lets a page complete even when a
    // connector can't be generated (e.g. a content-filter false-positive).
    if (i < N - 1 && CONNECTORS[i]) {
      SEGMENTS.push({ kind: 'conn', si: i, clip: CONNECTORS[i], clipM: CONNECTORS_M[i],
                      still: SECTIONS[i + 1].still, stillM: SECTIONS[i + 1].stillMobile,
                      accent: SECTIONS[i + 1].accent, w: CONN_W });
    }
  });
  const NSEG = SEGMENTS.length;

  // ---- DOM ----
  const sky = el('div', 'sw-sky');
  if (config.atmosphere !== false) {
    sky.appendChild(el('div', 'sw-sky__grad'));
    sky.appendChild(el('div', 'sw-sky__glow'));
  }
  const particles = el('div', 'sw-particles'); sky.appendChild(particles);

  const scrollbar = el('div', 'sw-scrollbar');
  const scrollbarFill = el('span'); scrollbar.appendChild(scrollbarFill);

  const topbar = el('div', 'sw-topbar');
  if (config.brand) {
    const brand = el('a', 'sw-brand'); brand.href = (config.brand.href || '#');
    brand.appendChild(el('span', 'sw-brand__mark'));
    const nm = el('span', 'sw-brand__name'); nm.textContent = config.brand.name || ''; brand.appendChild(nm);
    topbar.appendChild(brand);
  }
  const nav = el('nav', 'sw-nav'); if (config.nav !== false) topbar.appendChild(nav);
  if (config.cta && config.cta.label) {
    const c = el('a', 'sw-topcta'); c.href = config.cta.href || '#'; c.textContent = config.cta.label;
    topbar.appendChild(c);
  }

  const stage = el('div', 'sw-stage');
  const copylayer = el('div', 'sw-copylayer');
  const route = el('div', 'sw-route');
  const hint = el('div', 'sw-hint');
  const hintText = el('span'); hintText.textContent = config.hint || 'scroll'; hint.appendChild(hintText);
  hint.appendChild(el('i'));
  const track = el('div', 'sw-track');

  [sky, scrollbar, topbar, stage, copylayer, route, hint, track].forEach(n => container.appendChild(n));

  // segment scenes
  SEGMENTS.forEach(s => {
    const scene = el('div', 'sw-scene'); scene.style.setProperty('--sw-accent', s.accent || '');
    const img = el('img', 'sw-scene__still'); img.alt = ''; img.decoding = 'async'; img.loading = 'lazy';
    const poster = (isMobile() && s.stillM) ? s.stillM : s.still;
    if (poster) img.src = poster;
    scene.appendChild(img); stage.appendChild(scene);
    s.el = scene; s.img = img; s.video = null; s.hasClip = false;
    s.loading = false; s.ready = false; s.cur = 0; s.target = 0; s.visible = false;
  });

  // per-section copy / route / nav
  const copies = [], dots = [];
  SECTIONS.forEach((s, i) => {
    const c = el('article', 'sw-copy'); c.style.setProperty('--sw-accent', s.accent || '');
    c.innerHTML =
      `<span class="sw-copy__num">${pad(i + 1)} / ${pad(N)}</span>` +
      (s.eyebrow ? `<span class="sw-copy__eyebrow">${esc(s.eyebrow)}</span>` : '') +
      (s.title ? `<h2 class="sw-copy__title">${esc(s.title)}</h2>` : '') +
      (s.body ? `<p class="sw-copy__body">${esc(s.body)}</p>` : '') +
      (s.tags && s.tags.length ? `<ul class="sw-copy__tags">${s.tags.map(t => `<li>${esc(t)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>` : '') +
      (s.cta ? `<div class="sw-copy__cta">${ctaBtns(s.cta)}</div>` : '');
    copylayer.appendChild(c); copies.push(c);

    const dot = el('button', 'sw-route__dot'); dot.style.setProperty('--sw-accent', s.accent || '');
    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', s.label || ''); // KŌJI patch 4
    dot.innerHTML = `<span class="sw-route__label">${esc(s.label || '')}</span><i></i>`;
    dot.addEventListener('click', () => jumpTo(i)); route.appendChild(dot); dots.push(dot);

    if (config.nav !== false) {
      const b = el('button', 'sw-nav__item'); b.textContent = s.label || '';
      b.addEventListener('click', () => jumpTo(i)); nav.appendChild(b);
    }
  });

  // ---- math ----
  const clamp = (x, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, x));
  const smooth = x => { x = clamp(x); return x * x * (3 - 2 * x); };
  // Per-section dwell: monotone remap of scroll→time so the camera settles mid-scene
  // (where the copy peaks) and moves quicker near the seams. L=0 linear, L=1 full
  // mid-scene pause. f(0)=0, f(1)=1 always, so seam frames are untouched.
  const lingerEase = (x, L) => { L = clamp(L); const c = x - 0.5; return (1 - L) * x + L * (4 * c * c * c + 0.5); };
  let vh = window.innerHeight, stageX = 0, totalW = 0, activeIndex = -1, ticking = false;
  let laidOutW = window.innerWidth;   // width the current layout was computed at (see onResize)

  function layout() {
    vh = window.innerHeight;
    laidOutW = window.innerWidth;
    stageX = window.innerWidth > 860 ? 4 : 0;
    let off = 0;
    SEGMENTS.forEach(s => { s.start = off * vh; off += s.w; s.end = off * vh; });
    totalW = off;
    track.style.height = (totalW * vh + vh) + 'px';   // +1vh so the last flight completes
    read();
  }

  function jumpTo(i) {
    const seg = SECTIONS[i]._seg;
    window.scrollTo({ top: (config.originY ? config.originY() : 0) + seg.start + (seg.end - seg.start) * 0.5, behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth' }); // KŌJI patch 2
  }

  function loadClip(s) {
    // Under prefers-reduced-motion we never load the clips at all — the stills stay up
    // and simply cross-dissolve as you scroll. No scrubbed video motion, no decode cost.
    if (reduce || s.loading || !s.clip) return;
    s.loading = true;
    // Serve the lighter mobile encode on phones when one was provided.
    const url = (isMobile() && s.clipM) ? s.clipM : s.clip;
    fetch(url).then(r => r.ok ? r.blob() : Promise.reject(new Error('404')))
      .then(blob => {
        const v = document.createElement('video');
        v.className = 'sw-scene__video';
        v.muted = true; v.playsInline = true; v.preload = 'auto';
        v.setAttribute('muted', ''); v.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
        v.src = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => { s.ready = true; read(); });
        // Reveal the video (hide the still poster) only once a real frame has
        // painted — on iOS a seeked-but-never-played muted video stays blank, so
        // hiding the still on metadata alone would flash an empty scene.
        v.addEventListener('seeked', () => { s.el.classList.add('has-clip'); }, { once: true });
        v.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => { try { v.pause(); } catch (e) {} if (userReady) primeVideo(v); });
        s.el.appendChild(v); s.video = v; s.hasClip = true;
      }).catch(() => { s.loading = false; });
  }

  function read() {
    const y = config.scrollY ? config.scrollY() : (window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset); // KŌJI patch 1
    const fade = CROSSFADE * vh;
    let ci = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < NSEG; i++) if (y >= SEGMENTS[i].start) ci = i;

    for (let i = 0; i < NSEG; i++) {
      const s = SEGMENTS[i];
      if (y > s.start - 1.6 * vh && y < s.end + 1.6 * vh) loadClip(s);
      const local = clamp((y - s.start) / (s.end - s.start), 0, 1);
      s.target = s.linger ? lingerEase(local, s.linger) : local;
      let outside = 0;
      if (y < s.start) outside = s.start - y; else if (y > s.end) outside = y - s.end;
      const op = smooth(1 - outside / fade);
      s.el.style.opacity = op; s.visible = op > 0.001;
      s.el.style.zIndex = (i === ci) ? '120' : String(100 + Math.round(op * 10));
      if (!s.hasClip || !s.ready) {
        const sc = reduce ? 1 : 1.03 + local * 0.14;
        s.img.style.transform = `translateX(${stageX - 2}vw) scale(${sc.toFixed(3)})`;
      }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      const seg = SECTIONS[i]._seg;
      const pr = clamp((y - seg.start) / (seg.end - seg.start), 0, 1);
      const before = y < seg.start, after = y > seg.end;
      let cop;
      if (i === 0) cop = after ? 0 : smooth(1 - pr / 0.62);            // greets on landing
      else if (i === N - 1) cop = before ? 0 : smooth(pr / 0.4);       // holds CTA at the end
      else cop = (before || after) ? 0 : smooth(1 - Math.abs(pr - 0.5) / 0.5);
      const c = copies[i];
      c.style.opacity = cop;
      c.style.transform = reduce ? 'none' : `translateY(${(0.5 - pr) * 4}vh)`;
      c.style.pointerEvents = cop > 0.5 ? 'auto' : 'none';
    }

    const cur = SEGMENTS[ci];
    const near = clamp(cur.kind === 'dive' ? cur.si
      : (((y - cur.start) / (cur.end - cur.start)) > 0.5 ? cur.si + 1 : cur.si), 0, N - 1);
    if (near !== activeIndex) {
      activeIndex = near;
      dots.forEach((d, k) => d.classList.toggle('is-active', k === near));
      nav.querySelectorAll('.sw-nav__item').forEach((n, k) => n.classList.toggle('is-active', k === near));
      container.style.setProperty('--sw-accent', SECTIONS[near].accent || '');
    }
    scrollbarFill.style.transform = `scaleX(${clamp(y / (totalW * vh))})`;
    hint.style.opacity = clamp(1 - y / (0.5 * vh));
    if (particles) particles.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${-y * 0.05}px, 0)`;
    ticking = false;
  }

  function raf() {
    const eps = isMobile() ? 0.02 : 0.008;   // coarser seek step on phones = fewer decodes
    for (let i = 0; i < NSEG; i++) {
      const s = SEGMENTS[i];
      if (!s.hasClip || !s.ready || !s.video) continue;
      // Never queue a seek while the decoder is still resolving the last one.
      // On phones a fast flick would otherwise pile up seeks and freeze the clip;
      // cur keeps lerping, so we snap to the latest target the moment it's free.
      if (s.video.seeking) continue;
      if (!s.visible && Math.abs(s.cur - s.target) < 0.002) continue;
      s.cur += (s.target - s.cur) * (reduce ? 1 : 0.18);
      const dur = s.video.duration || 1;
      const t = clamp(s.cur, 0, 0.999) * dur;
      if (Math.abs(s.video.currentTime - t) > eps) { try { s.video.currentTime = t; } catch (e) {} }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(raf);
  }

  // iOS needs a user gesture before a muted video will decode/paint reliably. On the
  // first touch we prime every loaded clip (muted play→pause) so the first seek is
  // instant instead of showing a blank frame. `userReady` also makes freshly-loaded
  // clips prime themselves (see loadClip).
  let userReady = false;
  function primeVideo(v) {
    if (!isMobile() || !v) return;
    try { const p = v.play(); if (p && p.then) p.then(() => { try { v.pause(); } catch (e) {} }).catch(() => {}); }
    catch (e) {}
  }
  function onFirstGesture() {
    if (userReady) return;
    userReady = true;
    SEGMENTS.forEach(s => primeVideo(s.video));
  }
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', onFirstGesture, { once: true, passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('touchstart', onFirstGesture, { once: true, passive: true });

  // Particles are a per-frame cost we can't afford alongside video scrubbing on a phone.
  seedParticles(particles, reduce || coarse);
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(read); } }, { passive: true });
  // Mobile browsers fire `resize` every time the URL bar slides in/out. Re-running
  // layout() there rebuilds the track height and yanks the scroll position, so on
  // touch we ignore height-only changes and only relayout when the width actually
  // changes (rotation still comes through orientationchange). layout() records the
  // width it laid out at.
  function onResize() {
    if (coarse && window.innerWidth === laidOutW) return;
    layout();
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', layout);
  window.addEventListener('load', layout);
  layout();
  requestAnimationFrame(raf);

  // ---- helpers ----
  function el(tag, cls) { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; return n; }
  function pad(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c])); }
  function ctaBtns(cta) {
    let h = '';
    if (cta.primary) h += `<a class="sw-btn sw-btn--primary" href="${esc(cta.primary.href || '#')}">${esc(cta.primary.label)}</a>`;
    if (cta.secondary) h += `<a class="sw-btn sw-btn--ghost" href="${esc(cta.secondary.href || '#')}">${esc(cta.secondary.label)}</a>`;
    return h;
  }
}

function seedParticles(host, reduce) {
  if (!host || reduce) return;
  const kinds = ['dot', 'dot', 'ring'];
  const seeds = [7, 23, 41, 58, 71, 88, 12, 34, 52, 66, 83, 95, 18, 29, 47, 63, 77, 91, 5, 38, 55, 69, 82, 97];
  for (let k = 0; k < 20; k++) {
    const s = document.createElement('span');
    s.className = 'sw-pt sw-pt--' + kinds[k % kinds.length];
    s.style.left = seeds[k % seeds.length] + 'vw';
    s.style.top = ((seeds[(k * 3) % seeds.length] * 1.3) % 100) + 'vh';
    s.style.setProperty('--sw-sc', (0.5 + ((seeds[(k * 5) % seeds.length] % 60) / 60) * 1.1).toFixed(2));
    const dur = 14 + (seeds[(k * 7) % seeds.length] % 22);
    s.style.animationDuration = dur + 's';
    s.style.animationDelay = (-(seeds[(k * 2) % seeds.length] % dur)) + 's';
    host.appendChild(s);
  }
}

function injectCSS() {
  if (document.getElementById('sw-css')) return;
  const css = `
  .sw-root{--sw-bg:#F5EDE0;--sw-ink:#241d2b;--sw-ink-soft:#6a6072;--sw-accent:#8a7bb5;
    --sw-font-display:ui-rounded,"SF Pro Rounded","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;
    --sw-font-body:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif;
    color:var(--sw-ink);font-family:var(--sw-font-body);}
  /* KŌJI patch 3: removed html,body{overflow-x:hidden} — it makes <body> a scroll container and breaks every sticky element on the host page. */
  .sw-sky{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;background:var(--sw-bg);}
  .sw-sky__grad{position:absolute;inset:-10%;background:linear-gradient(178deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 12%,var(--sw-bg)) 0%,var(--sw-bg) 55%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 6%,var(--sw-bg)) 100%);}
  .sw-sky__glow{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(60% 42% at 74% 16%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 22%,transparent),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(46% 34% at 50% 50%,color-mix(in srgb,#fff 45%,transparent),transparent 70%);}
  .sw-particles{position:absolute;inset:-6% -2%;will-change:transform;}
  .sw-pt{position:absolute;width:13px;height:13px;transform:scale(var(--sw-sc,1));opacity:0;animation:sw-drift linear infinite;}
  .sw-pt::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;}
  .sw-pt--dot::before{background:radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 60%,#000),#000 82%);}
  .sw-pt--ring::before{background:transparent;border:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 55%,transparent);}
  @keyframes sw-drift{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(var(--sw-sc)) translate(0,12vh) rotate(0)}12%{opacity:.5}88%{opacity:.45}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(var(--sw-sc)) translate(4vw,-22vh) rotate(210deg)}}
  .sw-scrollbar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;z-index:60;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 14%,transparent);}
  .sw-scrollbar span{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0);background:var(--sw-accent);}
  .sw-topbar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:50;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:clamp(14px,2.4vw,26px) clamp(18px,5vw,64px);}
  .sw-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--sw-ink);}
  .sw-brand__mark{width:24px;height:28px;border-radius:7px 7px 10px 10px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--sw-accent),color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 60%,#000));box-shadow:0 6px 14px color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 40%,transparent);}
  .sw-brand__name{font-family:var(--sw-font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;}
  .sw-nav{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:5px;background:color-mix(in srgb,#fff 55%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 16%,transparent);border-radius:999px;}
  .sw-nav__item{font:inherit;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--sw-ink-soft);border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;transition:color .25s,background .25s;}
  .sw-nav__item:hover{color:var(--sw-ink);} .sw-nav__item.is-active{color:#fff;background:var(--sw-accent);}
  .sw-topcta{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;color:#fff;background:var(--sw-ink);padding:10px 20px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;}
  .sw-stage{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;pointer-events:none;}
  .sw-scene{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden;will-change:opacity;}
  .sw-scene__video,.sw-scene__still{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 42%;}
  .sw-scene__still{will-change:transform;} .sw-scene.has-clip .sw-scene__still{opacity:0;} .sw-scene__video{z-index:1;}
  .sw-copylayer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;pointer-events:none;}
  .sw-copylayer::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;width:min(58vw,780px);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--sw-bg) 0%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-bg) 82%,transparent) 34%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-bg) 40%,transparent) 62%,transparent 100%);}
  .sw-copy{position:absolute;left:clamp(18px,5vw,64px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:min(42vw,460px);opacity:0;will-change:opacity,transform;}
  .sw-copy__num{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--sw-ink-soft);}
  .sw-copy__eyebrow{display:block;margin-top:18px;font-family:var(--sw-font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sw-accent);}
  .sw-copy__title{font-family:var(--sw-font-display);font-weight:700;color:var(--sw-ink);font-size:clamp(2rem,4.4vw,3.5rem);line-height:1.03;margin:12px 0 0;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-shadow:0 2px 20px color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-bg) 70%,transparent);}
  .sw-copy__body{margin-top:18px;font-size:clamp(1rem,1.25vw,1.14rem);line-height:1.55;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-ink) 78%,var(--sw-ink-soft));max-width:40ch;text-shadow:0 1px 12px color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-bg) 90%,transparent);}
  .sw-copy__tags{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:24px 0 0;padding:0;}
  .sw-copy__tags li{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 70%,#000);padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 14%,#fff);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 30%,transparent);}
  .sw-copy__cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:28px;pointer-events:auto;}
  .sw-btn{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;padding:13px 24px;border-radius:999px;transition:transform .2s;}
  .sw-btn--primary{color:#fff;background:var(--sw-ink);} .sw-btn--primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .sw-btn--ghost{color:var(--sw-ink);border:1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-ink) 25%,transparent);} .sw-btn--ghost:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .sw-route{position:fixed;right:clamp(14px,2.4vw,30px);top:50%;z-index:40;transform:translateY(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;padding:18px 10px;}
  .sw-route::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:22px;bottom:22px;width:2px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--sw-accent);opacity:.28;}
  .sw-route__dot{position:relative;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;width:14px;height:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;}
  .sw-route__dot i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 40%,transparent);transition:transform .3s,background .3s,box-shadow .3s;}
  .sw-route__dot:hover i{transform:scale(1.25);background:var(--sw-accent);}
  .sw-route__dot.is-active i{background:var(--sw-accent);transform:scale(1.4);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 22%,transparent);}
  .sw-route__label{position:absolute;right:24px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(6px);white-space:nowrap;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--sw-ink);background:color-mix(in srgb,#fff 85%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);padding:5px 11px;border-radius:999px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-accent) 14%,transparent);}
  .sw-route__dot:hover .sw-route__label,.sw-route__dot.is-active .sw-route__label{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(0);}
  .sw-hint{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;z-index:30;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sw-ink-soft);transition:opacity .3s;}
  .sw-hint i{width:22px;height:34px;border-radius:12px;border:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-ink) 28%,transparent);position:relative;}
  .sw-hint i::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:7px;width:4px;height:7px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--sw-accent);transform:translateX(-50%);animation:sw-wheel 1.7s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes sw-wheel{0%{opacity:0;top:6px}40%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;top:17px}}
  .sw-track{position:relative;z-index:1;width:100%;pointer-events:none;}
  @media (max-width:860px){
    .sw-nav{display:none;}
    .sw-copylayer::before{width:100%;height:60%;top:auto;bottom:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,var(--sw-bg) 8%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--sw-bg) 70%,transparent) 46%,transparent 100%);}
    /* Anchor copy to the bottom, clear of the home indicator / collapsing URL bar.
       dvh + env() are progressive: browsers that lack them keep the vh fallback line. */
    .sw-copy{left:clamp(18px,5vw,64px);right:clamp(18px,5vw,64px);top:auto;bottom:clamp(64px,14vh,120px);transform:none;width:auto;max-width:560px;}
    .sw-copy{bottom:calc(clamp(56px,12dvh,110px) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));}
    .sw-copy__title{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,7.5vw,2.7rem);}
    .sw-copy__body{max-width:none;font-size:clamp(.98rem,3.6vw,1.1rem);} .sw-scene__video,.sw-scene__still{object-position:center 46%;}
    .sw-hint{bottom:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));}
    .sw-route{gap:16px;right:6px;} .sw-route__label{display:none;}
  }
  /* Portrait phones crop a 16:9 clip hard; keep the framing centred so the focal
     subject (which the camera dives toward) stays in view. */
  @media (max-width:860px) and (orientation:portrait){
    .sw-scene__video,.sw-scene__still{object-position:center 44%;}
  }
  /* Touch: give the route dots a finger-sized hit area without growing the visible dot. */
  @media (hover:none) and (pointer:coarse){
    .sw-route{padding:14px 6px;}
    .sw-route__dot{width:28px;height:28px;}
    .sw-btn{padding:15px 26px;}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ .sw-hint i::after{animation:none;} .sw-pt{display:none;} }
  `;
  // Wrap in a cascade layer so the page's own theme tokens (unlayered
  // :root / .sw-root { --sw-bg / --sw-ink / --sw-accent … }) always win over
  // these defaults, regardless of injection order. Enables clean dark themes.
  const style = document.createElement('style'); style.id = 'sw-css';
  style.textContent = '@layer sw {\n' + css + '\n}';
  document.head.appendChild(style);
}

// Expose for module + global use.

<![CDATA[/**
 * A flat concrete panel that sweeps across the flight in 450 ms, covering a cut between two dives whose
 * connector clip couldn't be made seamless. Re-keyed by the parent to replay.
 */
export function SlabWipe({ playKey }: { playKey: number }) {
  if (!playKey) return null;
  return <div key={playKey} className="kj-slabwipe" aria-hidden="true" />;
}

    <file path="src/app/(koji)/koji/forms/reservation.ts">
<![CDATA[export type Reservation = { date: string; time: string; guests: number; name: string; email: string };
export type ReservationErrors = Partial<Record<keyof Reservation, string>>;

/** Two seatings a night, each split into two arrival times at the 12-seat counter. */
export const SEATINGS = ["18:00", "18:30", "20:45", "21:15"] as const;
export const MAX_GUESTS = 4;

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

/** `today` is injectable for tests; dates compare as local YYYY-MM-DD strings. */
export function validateReservation(input: Reservation, today: Date = new Date()): ReservationErrors {
  const errors: ReservationErrors = {};
  const todayISO = [today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth() + 1, today.getDate()]
    .map((n, i) => String(n).padStart(i === 0 ? 4 : 2, "0"))
    .join("-");
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(input.date) || input.date < todayISO) errors.date = "Choose a date from today";
  if (!(SEATINGS as readonly string[]).includes(input.time)) errors.time = "Choose one of the four seatings";
  if (!Number.isInteger(input.guests) || input.guests < 1 || input.guests > MAX_GUESTS) errors.guests = "Parties of 1–4 only";
  if (!input.name.trim()) errors.name = "Add your name";
  if (!EMAIL.test(input.email.trim())) errors.email = "Enter a valid email";
  return errors;
}
]]>
